summary: Iteration 5 — Landing feature-bullet interactivity + WeatherBackground + always-visible Ask AI regression. Backend: 26/26 pytest passed in 7.68s (no backend changes). Frontend: PRIMARY fix verified — all 4 landing bullets (bullet-quiz, bullet-explorer, bullet-savesmart, bullet-leaderboard) now navigate to /quiz, /explorer, /save-smart, /leaderboard respectively. Weather background layer (data-testid='weather-bg') renders with gradient; weather-chip renders with fallback text 'TaxQuest' (ipapi.co blocked by CORS in preview env — expected). Ask AI pill (data-testid='open-chatbot-btn') visible on landing AND dashboard AND leaderboard with 'Ask AI' label. Guest chatbot upsell (chatbot-signin/chatbot-signup) works — chatbot-signin navigates to /login. Admin sign-in (admin@taxmaster.pro/Admin@123) succeeds, chat panel switches to streaming interface, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 reply for 'Explain GST briefly' streamed in ~3s. Translucent cards render over weather gradient.
critical_code_review_comments: WeatherBackground.jsx ipapi.co fallback triggers a CORS error in this preview env (Access-Control-Allow-Origin missing). Not user-visible (chip still renders 'TaxQuest'), but pollutes console with red errors. Recommend: wrap the ipapi fetch in try/catch that already exists but consider using a CORS-friendly endpoint (e.g., https://ipwho.is/, https://ipapi.co with query-string alt) OR silently swallow the CORS failure without logging red console errors. Currently a warning is logged via console.warn but the fetch itself surfaces browser-level red errors that cannot be suppressed from JS.

Geolocation.getCurrentPosition timeout is 5s but no maximumAge on error → in headless browsers where geolocation is silently denied without prompting the error callback promptly, the chip stays as 'TaxQuest' forever. Consider adding a 6-7s watchdog that forces the ipapi fallback if neither success nor error fires within that window.
Landing.jsx auto-redirects authed users to /dashboard (unchanged from prev iteration) — still no way for authed user to view '/' after signing in.

Chatbot.jsx: guest upsell branch works, but the input form is entirely hidden for guests. Consider showing the input in disabled state with 'Sign in to chat' placeholder so guests see the affordance before clicking (currently the guest panel is only the upsell CTA).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows verified — bullets navigate, weather bg + chip render, Ask AI visible on all pages, guest upsell + admin streaming both working
